title: Targeting protein-ligand neosurfaces using a generalizable deep learning approach
summary: Targeting protein-ligand neosurfaces using a generalizable deep learning approach. Fingerprints trained on proteins were applied to protein-ligand neosurfaces to design binders. Binders were experimentally validated against three drug-bound protein complexes. Evidence limits: Preprint; affinities, failure rates and peer review not assessed (later journal version not checked). Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
